name: Natural Theologian
body:
Your study of theology has broadened your understanding of the natural world.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, must possess either the animal or plant cleric domains.

Benefit(s): For every 5 ranks you possess in Knowledge (religion) you gain a +1 competence bonus to Knowledge (nature) skill checks.
